title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for B_r(0) must be correctly stated as B_r(0) = mu_0 n I r / (4R).

title: Magnetic Field Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The derivation of the magnetic field B(z_0) must be correctly performed using the integral and limits provided.

title: Use of Geometry
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between z_0 and theta must be correctly applied to find sin(theta_0).

title: Differentiation Step
description: Important Criteria: The differentiation of B(z_0) with respect to z_0 must be correctly executed to find dB(z_0)/dz_0.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units of the final expression should be checked for consistency with magnetic field units (Tesla).

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing the factor of 1/2 in the final expression for B_r(0) is a common mistake.

title: Integration Limits
description: Pitfall Criteria: Incorrect limits of integration in the calculation of B(z_0) can lead to errors in the final answer.
